headline: SITCON 2 (SEVERE): Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 exploited; N-able N-central cloud offline over 33 zero-days; OpenSSH SSHole still exploited

bullets.text: Changed: Google's Chrome security update fixes CVE-2026-125350, the eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026. SITCON holds at 2 (SEVERE) on 4 CISA KEV additions in 72 hours and 3 critical reports in 48 hours.
Changed: N-able took its hosted N-central cloud offline after a researcher disclosed 33 zero-days with proof-of-concept exploits. Earlier reports put the count at 30+.

SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, an authentication bypass) is still being used to breach Linux systems, now covered by 6 outlets. In CISA KEV since 11-09 alongside GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218; all four are due 11-12.

Cloud trust abuse: attackers used Qubole's trusted access into customer AWS accounts to breach them and steal data. A separate report describes attackers backdooring trusted AWS integrations to steal secrets.
Supply chain: Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop were compromised to deliver wallet-stealing malware. 300 malicious packages were listed in the GitHub Advisory Database in 7 days, almost all npm.

Still developing: Vanderbilt University hit by ransomware via BYOD devices, with data theft claimed; Beget rebuilding after a wiper attack; breaches at Iris Ohyama (7.7M), Frontline Education (3M+), Revolve (1.5M) and Amplifon Americas (1.3M). The last 7 days ran 0.84x the 90-day average.

actions: Update Chrome on all endpoints to the latest release (fixes CVE-2026-125350) and restart browsers; confirm managed fleets picked it up.
N-central users: plan for the hosted outage, limit network exposure of N-central servers and agents, and watch N-able for fixes.
Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
Audit IAM roles that trust third-party AWS accounts; remove unused integrations such as Qubole and rotate secrets they could reach.
Clear remaining KEV deadlines: VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (11-11), Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (11-13), SonicWall SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 (11-20).
